title: The weak pinned planar distance theorem
summary: We prove the weak pinned Erdős distinct-distance conjecture. For every fixed ε > 0, all but $`o(n)`$ points of any n -point planar set determine at least $`n^{1-\varepsilon}`$ distinct nonzero distances.
family_title: Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds

review.reason: Proves a weak pinned version of the Erdős distinct-distance conjecture for planar point sets.
